cards.ex: That cat video is going viral; everyone's sharing it!
cards.exUz: O'sha mushuk videosi tarqalib ketyapti; hamma ulashmoqda!
cards.uzDef: Internetda tez va keng tarqalish, juda mashhur bo'lib ketish.

cards.ex: I need to stop doomscrolling before I get too depressed.
cards.exUz: Depressiyaga tushib qolmasimdan oldin yomon yangiliklar o'qishni to'xtatishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda yomon yangiliklar haqida ma'lumot qidirish va o'qish.

cards.ex: Be careful what you post; it's part of your digital footprint.
cards.exUz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, nimani joylashtirsangiz; bu sizning raqamli izingizning bir qismidir.
cards.uzDef: Internetda qoldirgan barcha ma'lumotlar, xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: I need to unplug for a weekend and go camping.
cards.exUz: Dam olish kunlarida o'chib, lagerga borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Elektron qurilmalardan dam olish, raqamli hayotdan uzilish.

cards.ex: Cyberbullying is a serious problem that needs to be addressed.
cards.exUz: Kiberbulling hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan jiddiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali tahqirlash, qo'rqitish yoki haqorat qilish.

cards.ex: I almost fell for a phishing scam, but I caught it in time.
cards.exUz: Men deyarli firibgarlik qurboni bo'layozdim, lekin vaqtida sezib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Soxta elektron pochta orqali shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni o'g'irlashga urinish.

cards.ex: The company announced a massive data breach affecting millions of users.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya millionlab foydalanuvchilarga ta'sir qiluvchi katta ma'lumotlar buzilishini e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarning ruxsatsiz ochilishi yoki o'g'irlanishi.

cards.ex: Building a strong online presence is crucial for businesses today.
cards.exUz: Bugungi kunda biznes uchun kuchli onlayn mavjudlikni yaratish juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Internetda shaxs yoki biznesning mavjudligi, profillari.

cards.ex: Social media helps people stay connected with friends and family.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media odamlarga do'stlar va oila bilan bog'lanib turishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Aloqada bo'lish, doimiy ravishda xabar almashish.

cards.ex: I can spend hours just scrolling through Instagram.
cards.exUz: Men soatlab Instagramni varaqlab o'tirishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Telefon yoki kompyuter ekranida tezda pastga yoki yuqoriga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His addiction to video games is affecting his grades.
cards.exUz: Uning video o'yinlarga qaramligi baholariga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga haddan tashqari bog'lanib qolish, undan voz kecha olmaslik.

cards.ex: Social media can create a filter bubble, limiting your perspectives.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media sizning qarashlaringizni cheklab, filtr pufakchasini yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Faqat o'z fikrlariga mos ma'lumotlarni ko'rish va boshqa fikrlardan uzilish.

cards.ex: The company is known for its cutting-edge technology.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya eng zamonaviy texnologiyasi bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi va rivojlangan texnologiya.

cards.ex: Here's a life hack: use a password manager to keep your accounts secure.
cards.exUz: Mana hayotiy fokus: hisoblaringizni xavfsiz saqlash uchun parol menejeridan foydalaning.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik muammolarni osonroq hal qilish usuli.

cards.ex: My grandma is surprisingly tech-savvy for her age.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim yoshiga nisbatan hayratlanarli darajada texnologiyani biladi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyadan yaxshi foydalana oladigan odam.

cards.ex: I back up all my photos to cloud storage.
cards.exUz: Men barcha rasmlarimni bulutli xotiraga zaxiralamayman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarni Internetda saqlash.

cards.ex: That streaming service is a bandwidth hog; it slows down my internet.
cards.exUz: Ushbu striming xizmati traffik yeyuvchi; u mening internetimni sekinlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta hajmdagi internet traffikini ishlatadigan dastur yoki qurilma.

cards.ex: Don't feed the internet trolls; just ignore them.
cards.exUz: Internet trollarini boqmang; ularga e'tibor bermang.
cards.uzDef: Internetda boshqalarni g'azablantirishga urinadigan odam.

cards.ex: The digital divide is a major issue in many developing countries.
cards.exUz: Raqamli tafovut ko'plab rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda katta muammo.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiyalardan foydalanish imkoniyatidagi tengsizlik.

cards.ex: I dream of having a smart home that controls everything.
cards.exUz: Men hamma narsani boshqaradigan aqlli uyga ega bo'lishni orzu qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Avtomatlashtirilgan va internetga ulangan uy.

cards.ex: Stop phubbing me! It's rude.
cards.exUz: Meni telefonga tikilishni bas qiling! Bu odobsizlik.
cards.uzDef: Suhbat paytida telefon bilan mashg'ul bo'lib, sherikni e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

cards.ex: They used a catchy headline to get more clicks on the article.
cards.exUz: Ular maqolaga ko'proq bosishlar olish uchun diqqatni tortuvchi sarlavhadan foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jalb qiladigan va esda qoladigan sarlavha.

cards.ex: My email account got hacked last week.
cards.exUz: Mening elektron pochta hisobim o'tgan hafta buzib kirildi.
cards.uzDef: Hisob yoki tizimga ruxsatsiz kirish.

cards.ex: I use my voice assistant to set reminders and play music.
cards.exUz: Men ovozli yordamchimdan eslatmalar o'rnatish va musiqa tinglash uchun foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz orqali buyruqlarni qabul qiladigan dastur.

cards.ex: I stream videos on YouTube every night.
cards.exUz: Men har kecha YouTube-da video oqimini tomosha qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Internet orqali videoni yuklab olmasdan ko'rish.

cards.ex: She's a social influencer with millions of followers.
cards.exUz: U millionlab obunachilarga ega bo'lgan ijtimoiy ta'sirchi.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda katta ta'sirga ega bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: I called tech support to fix my computer.
cards.exUz: Men kompyuterimni tuzatish uchun texnik qo'llab-quvvatlashga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
cards.uzDef: Texnik muammolarni hal qilishda yordam beradigan xizmat.

cards.ex: It's important to be able to spot fake news online.
cards.exUz: Internetda soxta yangiliklarni aniqlay olish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan, yolg'on ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: She went live on Instagram to talk about her new product.
cards.exUz: U yangi mahsuloti haqida gapirish uchun Instagramda jonli efirga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Real vaqtda video translyatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: He's a power user of Photoshop; he knows all the tricks.
cards.exUz: U Photoshopning tajribali foydalanuvchisi; u barcha hiyla-nayranglarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Dasturiy ta'minotdan yoki tizimdan juda yaxshi foydalana oladigan odam.
